## Try it

1. Start the notes server: `quarto run _extensions/annotate/server.ts`
2. Preview this page: `quarto preview example-doc.qmd`
3. Press **A**, click anything on the page, and type a note

## Something to annotate

This paragraph is too long and says the same thing twice. It says the same thing twice, and it is too long.

- Maybe this bullet should come first
- This one could be cut

| Option | Default   |
|--------|-----------|
| port   | 4850      |
| host   | 127.0.0.1 |

## Then ask your assistant

Tell your coding assistant to "resolve the annotations in `example-doc.annotations.json`."

Pins stay attached to the paragraph, bullet, or cell you clicked, so they follow the text when the page reflows.
